references.text: Eliab son of Helon is mentioned again as the leader of the tribe of Zebulun during the organization of the camp.
Eliab son of Helon brings his offering as the prince of the tribe of Zebulun at the dedication of the altar.
Eliab son of Helon leads the army of Zebulun when the Israelites break camp from Sinai.
Zebulun was born as Leah's sixth son, and the tribe bears his name.
Jacob's blessing over Zebulun, the patriarch of the tribe of Zebulun.
